# Carthagent Cloud control-plane API

Version 1.1.2. OpenAPI source: [cloud.openapi.json](cloud.openapi.json).

Express router exported by lib/cloud/http.mjs (`cloudRouter`).

Device authorization, CLI sessions, account and usage reads, billing and an OpenAI-compatible model gateway. The hosting service mounts the router; paths below are relative to that mount point. JSON bodies are limited to 1 MB (the Stripe webhook takes a raw body up to 256 KB). OAuth-style failures answer `{"error": "<code>"}` with status 401 (`invalid_grant`, `invalid_token`, `revoked_token`, `access_denied`), 428 (`authorization_pending`), 410 (`expired_token`), 403 (`insufficient_scope`) or 400. Errors raised inside asynchronous handlers reach the router error handler, which answers 401 for `unauthorized` and `browser_auth_not_configured` and 400 for everything else. Gateway errors use the OpenAI error envelope.

Servers: `{base}`.

## Authentication

- `bearerAuth` (HTTP bearer): Access token from /v1/device/token or /v1/token/refresh. Scopes are carried in the `scope` claim: `models:read`, `gateway:invoke`, `account:read`. Sessions can be revoked server-side.

<a id="op-approvedeviceauthorization"></a>

### POST `/v1/device/authorizations/{userCode}/approve`

Approve or deny a device authorization from a signed-in browser.

Authenticated by the hosting service through the `authenticateBrowser(req)` hook (for example a website session cookie); no bearer token is used. Approval grants the one-time trial credit.

Operation ID: `approveDeviceAuthorization`. Auth: Browser session authenticated by the hosting service (`authenticateBrowser` hook).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `userCode` | path | string | yes | User code shown by the CLI (case-insensitive). |

**Request body** (optional)

Content type `application/json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `approve` | boolean | no | Send false to deny. (default `true`) |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Decision recorded. | application/json: {`approved`, `clientName`} |
| 400 | `invalid_user_code`, `expired_token`, or `authorization_<status>` when no longer pending. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | `unauthorized` (no browser account) or `browser_auth_not_configured`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |

<a id="op-createchatcompletion"></a>

### POST `/v1/chat/completions`

Create a chat completion through the gateway.

OpenAI-compatible chat completions proxy. The request body is forwarded to the upstream model; the upstream status code, safe headers and (possibly streamed) body are relayed unchanged, and usage is charged to the account ledger. Token failures pass through the router error handler and therefore answer 400 `{"error":"invalid_token"}` (or `expired_token`, `revoked_token`, `insufficient_scope`), not 401.

Operation ID: `createChatCompletion`. Auth: `bearerAuth (scope: gateway:invoke)`

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | no | Operation key; reusing it with a different body fails with `idempotency_key_reused`. |
| `X-Client-Request-Id` | header | string | no |  |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`.

Schema: [GatewayRequest](#schema-gatewayrequest)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | string | yes | Gateway model alias from /v1/models. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Upstream response relayed as-is (JSON or `text/event-stream`). Other upstream status codes are relayed the same way. | application/json: object; text/event-stream: string |
| 400 | Invalid request (`model_not_found`, `request_too_large`, `max_output_tokens_exceeded`, `idempotency_key_reused`, `request_reconciliation_required`) as a GatewayError, or `{"error": "<code>"}` for a token failure (`invalid_token`, `expired_token`, `revoked_token`, `insufficient_scope`) or another gateway failure. | application/json: [GatewayError](#schema-gatewayerror) or [Error](#schema-error) |
| 429 | `insufficient_quota`: Cloud credit is exhausted. | application/json: [GatewayError](#schema-gatewayerror) |
| 503 | `gateway_not_configured`. | application/json: [GatewayError](#schema-gatewayerror) |

<a id="op-stripewebhook"></a>

### POST `/v1/webhooks/stripe`

Receive a signed Stripe event.

The raw body is verified against the `stripe-signature` header (5 minute tolerance) before processing. Events are idempotent by Stripe event ID.

Operation ID: `stripeWebhook`. Auth: Stripe signature in the `stripe-signature` header.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stripe-signature` | header | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`.

Schema: object

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Event processed, or a duplicate was ignored. | application/json: {`duplicate`, `processed`} |
| 400 | Missing or invalid signature, or a malformed event. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
